Ivy L.: Quick sync: partner asks for final wording on marketplace blurb + an ops-friendly adapter runbook. Need to lock this week.
Marco P.: For blurb, keep it short: mention LangChain + Gateway adapter, partner trial SKU, recommended H100/A100 note.
Selina (HW): We'll provide quantized perf deltas. Note: INT8 on H100 ~1.7x tokens/sec vs A100. Will attach sanitized chart.
NorthPoint PM: Can you confirm the fallback behavior? If GPU quota drops, what happens to in-flight requests?
Marco P.: Fallback policy: new requests route to cpu_quantized; in-flight tokens continue on existing KV cache instance until finished. We emit adapter.fallback.triggered metric.
Todd (Marketplace): SKU constraints: keep name <=60 chars. Proposed: "Gateway-Adapter-LangChain-Trial-[NorthPoint]". I'll hold listing in partner-drafts until we get assets + legal.
LegalBot: Co-mark request queued (REQ-7811). Need partner-signed logo use form before public preview.
Ivy L.: Action list:
- Selina: upload perf artifact (SVG/PNG)
- Marco: publish runbook snippet (manifest + fallback snippet)
- Todd: draft marketplace blurb and hold SKU
- NorthPoint PM: sign co-mark form + send logo SVG
Ivy L.: Tentative partner preview: Tue 2024-06-04. Public beta after legal signoff. Ping here with any slips.
